system.description: Fever imposes the indicated penalty to all actions until expiry. Only on application, a damage card offers Constitution resistance: success avoids the damage without removing fever or its penalty. This test does not repeat each round.
system.summary: Supernatural fever: penalty to all actions and risk of damage.
